problem: How does surface substitution govern atomic disorder-to-order phase transition during annealing in multi-component core-shell nanoparticles?
mechanism_or_method: In-situ electron microscopy and atomic-resolution element analysis show outward Pd diffusion forms (Pt,Pd)-Co surface phase lowering ordering temperature, supported by calculations.
limitation: Single model nanoparticle system; relevance to catalytic performance and other compositions not shown.

object: giant magnetoelastic effect in soft magnetic composites
problem: Can a universal theory interpret the giant magnetoelastic effect in soft systems across deformation modes and geometries?
mechanism_or_method: Theoretical framework coupling micromagnet magnetization with soft-matter deformation, predicting phenomena such as magnetic pole reversal under localized compression.
limitation: Validation relies on prior experiments; abstract does not detail experimental scope or conditions.
decision_relevance: Guides design of soft magnetoelastic energy and sensing devices.

problem: Can taste be remotely sensed and replicated chemically for VR/AR through coupled sensors and actuators?
mechanism_or_method: Wireless-coupled chemical sensors and actuators using five basic taste chemicals, co-designed for tunability, safety and mechanical robustness.
limitation: Limited taste set and human-subject testing scale; long-term safety and sensor stability unclear.

object: cholesteric liquid crystal elastomer sheath-core mechanochromic fibres
problem: How to make mechanochromic fibres tough and low-hysteresis for detecting ultra-fast deformation in real-world textiles?
mechanism_or_method: Sheath-core composite fibre with thermoplastic elastomer core and CLCE sheath, tuning core modulus to reduce hysteresis.
limitation: Demonstrated at lab scale; durability in actual textiles and washing not shown.
decision_relevance: Choice of core elastomer modulus for mechanochromic smart textile fibres.

problem: How to raise electro-mechanical transduction efficiency and energy density of ionic actuators limited by interfacial ion transport?
mechanism_or_method: Polyrotaxane interface with sliding-ring effect synchronizing ion-channel switching with actuation strain, lowering interfacial ion transfer energy barrier.
limitation: Lab-scale devices; long-term cycling and in-tissue performance not detailed.

problem: Why does this azopolymer show cis-rich plasticity and photo-tunable adhesion, opposite to other azopolymers?
mechanism_or_method: End-group azobenzene isomerization alters supramolecular interactions with side-chain benzene rings, raising crosslinking density in cis state.
limitation: Interaction mechanism inferred indirectly; cis half-life 16.9 h limits switching stability.

problem: How to build bioinspired circumferential fibrous structures in hydrogels to combine toughness, fatigue resistance and compressibility?
mechanism_or_method: Concentric ice-templating via slow freezing plus rotary compression annealing creates circumferentially aligned architecture.
limitation: Lab-scale samples; scalability and long-term in-service robustness beyond 500 cycles not established.
decision_relevance: Informs hydrogel structure choice for robotic grippers and pressure-bearing soft components.

problem: How to program microrobots into robust reconfigurable collectives with large force output in harsh dynamic environments?
mechanism_or_method: Gradient magnetic fields induce strong inter-robot connections, enabling reconfigurable patterns and 700-fold output force enhancement.
limitation: Requires external magnetic field setup; demonstrated only in controlled laboratory conditions.

object: thin high-entropy oxide films on liquid gallium oxide
problem: How to controllably synthesize thin nano-sized high-entropy oxides with improved oxygen evolution activity?
mechanism_or_method: Native Ga2O3 layer on liquid gallium anchors metal ions and imposes strain, lowering OER free-energy barrier, supported by DFT.
limitation: Performance only compared with control groups; stability and scale-up not reported.

problem: How to enlarge the fracture process zone to achieve full-field energy dissipation and higher toughness in mechanical metamaterials?
mechanism_or_method: Integrate weak and strong bonds so sequential weak-bond breaking and plastic hinges redistribute stress; gradient designs shield surface cracks.
limitation: Tested on specimens of limited size and materials; dynamic or blast loading performance not demonstrated.
decision_relevance: Informs design of crack-tolerant protective structures and energy absorbers.

object: high-entropy nanoparticles confined in molecular sieves
problem: How to synthesize size-homogeneous, sinter-resistant high-entropy nanoparticles inside molecular sieves at scale?
mechanism_or_method: Quenching space-confined liquid metal droplets inside mesoporous/microporous sieves yields 1-5 nm HE-NPs; tested in propane dehydrogenation.
limitation: Catalytic validation limited to one proof-of-concept reaction; long-term stability not stated.

problem: Can a chiral COF membrane enantioseparate and fractionate amino acids with high permeability and selectivity?
mechanism_or_method: Homochiral ultra-microporous COF channels retard L-enantiomers through stronger interactions; two-stage cascade yields 99.5% D-threonine.
limitation: Lab-scale membrane; long-term stability and scale-up not addressed in abstract.

problem: How to overcome the sensitivity-stability trade-off in artificial mechanoreceptors for accurate multimodal object recognition?
mechanism_or_method: PVA/MXene hydrogel microneedles with non-faradaic PET/ITO junction boost piezoionic output; coupled with memristor units for recognition.
limitation: Recognition accuracy 90% on limited object set; laboratory device only.

object: wearable full-body motion tracking and haptic feedback system
problem: Can a low-cost wearable network provide full-body motion tracking with real-time bidirectional haptic feedback?
mechanism_or_method: Flexible patch-type epidermal haptic devices with remote machine-learning framework for synchronized tracking and personalized feedback.
limitation: Evaluated on limited users and tasks; long-term wearability and robustness not stated.

problem: Can pretreated food-waste biocrude be hydrotreated into drop-in sustainable aviation fuel meeting ASTM specifications?
mechanism_or_method: Single-stage CoMo catalytic hydrotreating with parameters screened by Taguchi method and optimized by response surface methodology.
limitation: Isomerization and freeze-point properties need further catalyst tuning; bench-scale only.

problem: How to combine compression-torsion and buckling mechanisms for high, smooth load plateaus in energy-absorbing metamaterials?
mechanism_or_method: Chiral multi-curved shell geometry couples compression-torsion with buckling, avoiding localized deformation and giving 20-fold higher specific energy absorption.
limitation: Tested on specific geometries and drop conditions; scalability and manufacturing variability not discussed.
decision_relevance: Selects metamaterial architecture for reusable lightweight impact protection.

object: vertically aligned 2D covalent organic framework membranes
problem: How to overcome insufficient permselectivity of 2D COF membranes for molecular separation?
mechanism_or_method: Self-templating interfacial assembly gives vertically aligned COF nanofilms with sub-4 angstrom interlayer channels, supported by molecular simulations.
limitation: Scalability is only claimed as potential; long-term operating stability not stated.

object: dual-gradient polyimide nanofiber/carbon nanotube aerogel sensor
problem: How to balance sensitivity and detection range in pressure sensors stable from cryogenic to high temperature?
mechanism_or_method: Bottom-up electrospinning, sequential freezing and thermal imidization create dual-gradient aerogel with flexible-to-rigid stiffness transition.
limitation: Spacesuit integration is prospective; tested at lab scale with limited physiological validation.

problem: How do cellular array structures and grain structures coevolve during alloy solidification?
mechanism_or_method: In situ microgravity solidification experiments on the ISS reveal cell invasion across grains, reproduced by phase-field simulations.
limitation: Microgravity transparent-alloy conditions may differ from terrestrial casting with convection.
decision_relevance: Reconsider grain-boundary models in casting, welding and additive manufacturing simulations.

problem: Does the wavy cell geometry of plant epidermis toughen tissue against fracture?
mechanism_or_method: Micro- and macroscopic fracture experiments combined with computational fracture mechanics and a multi-scale framework showing toughening by wavy cells.
limitation: Plant-adaptive significance inferred; generality across species and synthetic materials needs further validation.
decision_relevance: Informs crack-toughening pattern design in metamaterials and plant breeding.

problem: How do interconnected nanovoids form in polymer films and affect permeance and nanomechanical behaviour?
mechanism_or_method: Electron tomography, morphometry, graph theory and coarse-grained molecular dynamics link oligomer coalescence to void structure, permeance and modulus.
limitation: Demonstrated on polyamide membranes only; generality to other polymer films unproven.

object: chloroaluminate ionic liquid catalysts for polyolefin deconstruction
problem: What are the active species catalyzing low-temperature tandem cracking-alkylation of polyolefins in chloroaluminate ionic liquids?
mechanism_or_method: In situ NMR, Raman, XANES and operando IR plus ab initio MD identify AlCl3-tert-butyl chloride adducts generating carbenium ions.
limitation: Model feed experiments used n-hexadecane; real mixed plastic waste behaviour less characterised.

object: biomimetic nanofluidic channel for rare earth extraction
problem: Can an asymmetric functionalized nanochannel selectively extract Dy3+ from other lanthanide ions?
mechanism_or_method: Asymmetric channel functionalized with glycyl-L-proline amplifies Dy3+ affinity in nanoconfinement; simulations explain radius and coordination matching.
limitation: Single-channel lab demonstration; throughput and scale-up for practical recycling not shown.

problem: Can a wearable device deliver adjustable mechano-vibrotactile stimuli across multiple fingertip areas with high fidelity?
mechanism_or_method: Bioinspired adaptable multiplanar haptic system giving steady and vibrotactile stimuli up to 298 mN and 130 Hz, characterized with human sensitivity tests.
limitation: Human experiments limited in scale; clinical diagnostic utility not yet shown.

object: mechanophore-functionalized block copolymer under microprojectile impact
problem: How does a polymer dissipate energy at high strain rates, including shockwave attenuation?
mechanism_or_method: Mechanochemical activation maps subsurface energy absorption during microballistic impact, recovering acoustic wave velocity validated by simulation and acoustic measurements.
limitation: Single polymer system and shallow-depth deformation; generality to other materials not tested.
decision_relevance: Guides selection of polymers for high-strain-rate impact and shock protection.

object: structural superlubricity contact of graphene nanoflake-covered amorphous carbon
problem: How to achieve stable, humidity-insensitive macroscale solid superlubricity without wear or running-in?
mechanism_or_method: Au-capped graphite flake sliding on graphene nanoflake-covered hydrogen-free a-C reduces water pinning and oxidation, scaling to 3 mm ball contact.
limitation: Lab tribometer tests under limited loads and speeds; real component service conditions untested.
decision_relevance: Supports coating choices for low-friction contacts in humid environments.

object: frozen evanescent phonons in elastic metamaterials
problem: How do zero-frequency evanescent Bloch waves connect band-structure minima to static decay lengths in elastic metamaterials?
mechanism_or_method: Complex-plane Cauchy-Riemann analysis links band minima to frozen evanescent phonons; large decay lengths violate Saint Venant's principle.
limitation: Demonstrated for specific metamaterial designs; remote sensing application only suggested.
decision_relevance: Enables engineering of long static decay lengths for remote mechanical sensing.

problem: Can 2D MoS2 accelerate mechanically controlled radical polymerization for rapid hydrogel remodeling?
mechanism_or_method: MoS2 mechanoredox catalyst triggers polymerization of water-soluble monomers under ultrasound, ball milling and low-frequency vibration within minutes.
limitation: Applications such as artificial muscles and implants are only suggested; biocompatibility untested.

problem: Which start-up trajectories minimize fatigue damage in hydraulic turbines?
mechanism_or_method: Machine learning model trained on experimental stress data from reduced-scale model turbines is used to optimize start-up trajectory.
limitation: Validated on reduced-scale model turbines; transfer to full-size field machines not shown.
decision_relevance: Changes hydropower start-up trajectory scheduling to reduce fatigue damage.

problem: How do liquid-like and stress-driven atomic motions combine across the glass transition in a metallic glass?
mechanism_or_method: Temperature-scanning X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy at a fourth-generation synchrotron probes dynamics over six orders of timescale.
limitation: Single alloy composition and requires synchrotron beamtime; interpretation is a superposition model.

problem: What controls the acidification of lithium brines during evaporative concentration?
mechanism_or_method: Geochemical and boron isotope data from Salar de Uyuni combined with speciation modeling show boric acid dissociation dominates alkalinity and pH.
limitation: Primary data from one salar; global extension relies on compiled brine compositions.

problem: Can pore-surface fluorination in mesoporous COFs improve capture and separation of polarized perfluorinated gases?
mechanism_or_method: Isostructural fluorinated vs non-fluorinated mesoporous COFs; fluorine-induced gradient electric field exploits polarizability differences of guest molecules.
limitation: Ambient-condition adsorption only; regeneration cycling and industrial gas mixtures not detailed.

object: swarm cooperation model for multi-agent optimization and control
problem: Can a decentralized swarm model with few parameters perform reliably with small swarms for optimization and vehicle control?
mechanism_or_method: Combines meta-heuristic and consensus theory into a Swarm Cooperation Model balancing social, cognitive and stochastic terms; tested on 33 landscapes and simulated AUV contaminant search.
limitation: Computational proof of concept only; no physical vehicle validation, and wins on 22 of 33 landscapes.

problem: How to manage interfacial water to achieve robust underwater adhesion without sacrificing bulk cohesion?
mechanism_or_method: Water penetration confined to sub-8 micrometer depth: hydration-activated hydrogen bonds at interface and hydrophobic nanodomains maintain bulk integrity.
limitation: Lab peel tests on selected substrates; long-term marine durability not reported.
decision_relevance: Choice of adhesive design for water-resistant bonding in harsh wet environments.

object: zwitterionic bottle-brush grafted reverse osmosis membranes
problem: How to prevent mineral scaling in high-recovery brackish water desalination?
mechanism_or_method: Two-step grafting of high-density zwitterionic pseudo-bottle-brushes onto polyamide RO membranes; molecular dynamics shows surface screening of silica aggregation.
limitation: Long-term tests limited to specific brackish water; scale-up of grafting not addressed.

object: earthquake frequency-magnitude b-value and fault criticality
problem: What controls b-value variations in natural seismicity, and does b-value decrease near critical failure?
mechanism_or_method: Analysis of small earthquake sequences using a high-precision focal mechanism dataset relating b-value to stress criticality.
limitation: Relies on specific regional sequences; predictive skill for large earthquakes not demonstrated.
decision_relevance: Informs earthquake early-warning and hazard assessment using b-value monitoring.

problem: How does the free water surface assist ice nucleation?
mechanism_or_method: Brute-force molecular dynamics shows surface-induced negative pressure promotes Ice 0-like ring-topology precursors slightly below the surface.
limitation: Simulation only with a classical water model; no experimental confirmation of the proposed precursors.

object: global HCFC and HFC banks and emissions
problem: How large are time-lagged fluorocarbon emissions and what abatement potential exists after the Kigali Amendment?
mechanism_or_method: Dynamic material flow analysis of global stocks and flows 1986-2060 with business-as-usual and best-practice abatement scenarios.
limitation: Projections depend on scenario assumptions and bank estimates with uncertainty (about 3.7 Gt CO2-eq).
decision_relevance: Prioritises refrigerant bank recovery and destruction policies in developed economies.

problem: How to design alloys with temperature- and time-independent resistivity that are also strong and ductile?
mechanism_or_method: Multicomponent alloy design with lattice distortion, chemical short-range order and coherent nanoprecipitates promotes temperature-independent inelastic electron scattering.
limitation: Resistivity invariance shown only up to 723 K; single composition family.
decision_relevance: Material choice for precision resistors under high mechanical load and temperature swings.

object: stabilized nanocrystalline Cu-Ta alloys under shock
problem: Can nanocrystalline Cu-Ta resist damage accumulation under repeated shock loading?
mechanism_or_method: Repeated shock loading up to 12 GPa with microstructural characterization shows reversal or recovery of dislocation structure.
limitation: Tested up to 12 GPa on one alloy system; behaviour at higher pressures or other alloys unknown.
decision_relevance: Material selection for components facing repeated shock or impact loading.

problem: How to extend switching endurance of phase change memory and what causes stuck-RESET failure?
mechanism_or_method: Nano-confined cell with carbon-doped GeSbTe relocates melt-quench region to dielectric, lowering RESET energy; failure attributed to carbon accumulation.
limitation: Single device architecture and material; array-level reliability not discussed.

problem: Can pneumatic coding blocks implement If, If-break and For control statements in electronics-free soft robots?
mechanism_or_method: Nonlinear mechanical components form analog pneumatic coding blocks that combine into programs controlling an autonomous soft gripper.
limitation: Demonstrated on a single gripper; program complexity and scalability remain limited.
decision_relevance: Offers pneumatic logic design choice for autonomous soft robots without electronics.

problem: How to raise oscillation frequency and versatility of non-electrical pneumatic oscillators for robotic locomotion?
mechanism_or_method: Snap-through buckling beam, fabric chambers and switch valve create stiffness gradient, reaching 51 Hz and driving jumping, crawling and swimming robots.
limitation: Prototype robots tested in lab; endurance and operation in actual extreme environments not shown.
decision_relevance: Informs stiffness-gradient design of fast pneumatic oscillators for untethered robots.

object: oxide scale spalling on heat-resistant alloys
problem: What atomistic mechanism causes alumina oxide scale to spall from alloy matrix at high temperature?
mechanism_or_method: Trace sulfur segregates to scale-matrix interface forming weak S-rich layer, confirmed by atomistic simulation; microalloying removes segregation and improves adhesion.
limitation: Demonstrated on a model alloy at 900 C; generality to commercial alloys and conditions untested.
decision_relevance: Control sulfur impurity or microalloy to improve oxide scale adhesion in high-temperature alloys.

problem: How to locally reorient magnetic particles to give reprogrammable magnetoactuated deformation in soft actuators?
mechanism_or_method: Localized laser heating reduces viscoelastic pinning force of Fe3+-coordinated gel network, allowing NdFeB particle reorientation under modest field.
limitation: Lab demonstrations of sheets; reprogramming resolution and cycle durability not detailed.

problem: How to build a durable, moisture-permeable fabric with active thermoregulation that avoids heat and cold irritation?
mechanism_or_method: Hierarchical structural engineering reduces polymer chain aggregation and builds stress-dissipative networks in phase-change composite fibrous membranes.
limitation: Durability shown only to 50 washes and 500 rubs; wearer trials not reported.

object: disordered multilayer graphene reinforced copper composites
problem: How to break the strength-plasticity trade-off in nanograined metals?
mechanism_or_method: Plasma-assisted ball milling disperses sp2-sp3 disordered multilayer graphene; interlayer sliding and interface lattice strain promote dislocation accumulation.
limitation: Compressive properties only; tensile behavior and scalability of plasma ball milling not shown.
decision_relevance: Guides reinforcement design for strong yet plastic metal matrix composites.

object: flexible Zn-based MOF films for CO2 capture
problem: How much low-pressure CO2 can flexible MOF films reversibly capture and release under temperature and light stimuli?
mechanism_or_method: Quartz crystal microbalance, synchrotron infrared spectromicroscopy and GIWAXS track CO2 uptake as stimuli change framework pore environment.
limitation: Thin-film uptake at low pressure; capacity and cycling relevant to real carbon capture not quantified.

object: poly(ionic liquid) electrode for dielectric elastomer actuators
problem: How to make ultrasoft, rapidly self-healing electrodes that increase actuation strain of dielectric elastomer actuators?
mechanism_or_method: Ionic interaction regulation yields PIL electrode with 3.4 kPa modulus and 10 s self-healing, in air and underwater.
limitation: Lab-scale actuators; long-term electrical breakdown and cycling durability not detailed.
decision_relevance: Electrode material choice for self-healing soft grippers working in air or underwater.

object: photothermal liquid crystal elastomer underwater actuators
problem: How to manage heat dissipation to enhance photothermal actuation of soft robots in water?
mechanism_or_method: Superhydrophobic candle soot coating traps air plastron for insulation, raising work output 282-fold and enabling total-internal-reflection self-oscillation.
limitation: Plastron stability over long immersion and under flow or pressure not established; lab-scale robots.
decision_relevance: Add air-plastron insulation to underwater light-driven soft actuators.

object: multistage air-gap membrane distillation for DMF recovery
problem: Can waste-heat-driven membrane distillation recover high-value DMF solvent usable in perovskite solar cell manufacturing?
mechanism_or_method: Multistage air-gap membrane distillation enriches DMF from 0.3 to 94.2 wt%; recovered solvent used for perovskite minimodules.
limitation: Stable operation shown for only 60 hours at lab scale; industrial integration untested.
decision_relevance: Supports solvent recycling using waste heat in perovskite module manufacturing.

object: traffic crash prediction with large language models
problem: Can fine-tuned LLMs improve crash prediction and identify contributing risk factors from multimodal crash records?
mechanism_or_method: Textualize 58,903 crash reports into a dataset, fine-tune LLMs, and apply sentence-level feature attribution for conditional risk analysis.
limitation: Depends on crash report quality and region; causal interpretation of attributions is not established.
decision_relevance: Prioritises traffic safety interventions such as impaired driving and work zone countermeasures.

object: chemical short-range order in metallic alloys during processing
problem: How does chemical short-range order evolve during solidification and thermomechanical processing of alloys?
mechanism_or_method: High-fidelity atomistic simulations track SRO, revealing nonequilibrium steady states driven by an inherent ordering bias in nonequilibrium events.
limitation: Simulated rates exceed real processing; no direct experimental verification of nonequilibrium SRO states.
decision_relevance: Processing route can tune short-range order beyond equilibrium alloy design.

problem: How to achieve single-species K+/Na+ selective sieving in biomimetic membranes mimicking KcsA channels?
mechanism_or_method: In situ growth of carboxyl-rich 1D MOF inside 2D COF narrows pores and weakens K+-wall interaction, giving heterogeneous channels.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; operation in real mixed-ion streams and long-term stability not stated.

problem: How to recover uranium efficiently from concentrated nitric acid under intense radiation in spent fuel reprocessing?
mechanism_or_method: Metal-free g-C3N4 polymer with unsaturated nitrogen sites and pyrophosphate groups coordinates uranyl ions, stable in 12 M HNO3 and 500 kGy.
limitation: Proof-of-concept adsorption capacity 75.3 mg/g; real reprocessing streams and regeneration not tested.

object: slippery liquid-infused surfaces with hydrophilic bumps
problem: How to resolve the capture versus transport dilemma to achieve high-efficiency fog collection?
mechanism_or_method: Underwater infusion preserves hydrophilic bumps on SLIPS, combining beetle and pitcher-plant features; TiO2 bumps add photocatalytic purification.
limitation: Lab fog chamber tests; outdoor durability and lubricant retention not reported.

problem: How to make synthetic hydrogels as strong, stiff and tough as ligaments?
mechanism_or_method: Fiber-shaped polymer-particle hybrid agglomerates in a continuous matrix give efficient load transfer and energy dissipation, assembled into parallel bundles.
limitation: Fatigue and long-term in-vivo performance not reported; hydrogel fibers made at lab scale.

problem: How to integrate conformal actuation, sensing and electronics into autonomous soft robots using automated fabrication?
mechanism_or_method: Integrated digital light processing and direct ink writing printing, with lattice metamaterials, wavy interconnects and discretized printed circuit boards for stability.
limitation: Lab prototypes; electrical durability under repeated large deformation and printing throughput not quantified.

problem: How to raise piezoionic flex-sensitivity and resolve multi-DoF body motions with a single self-powered sensor?
mechanism_or_method: Zwitterionic dipole-ion interactions and steric hindrance amplify ion transport imbalance; square-prism fiber with two nanomesh electrode pairs decouples joint flexion.
limitation: Demonstrated on limited motions and users; long-term stability under humidity and wear not detailed.

problem: Can overtone photothermal imaging combine chemical specificity, sensitivity and spatial resolution for vibrational imaging?
mechanism_or_method: Visible probe detects local heating from C-H overtone absorption, imaging polymers, cancer cells, C. elegans and brain tissue.
limitation: Restricted to C-H overtone region; imaging depth in scattering tissue is limited.
